install: set -euo pipefail; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' ~/.bashrc 2>/dev/null || true; if [[ "$(uname -s)" == "Linux" ]]; then DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive sudo apt-get update -qq && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive sudo apt-get install -y zsh shellcheck libplist-utils binutils libgcc-13-dev libcurl4-openssl-dev libedit-dev libsqlite3-0 libstdc++-13-dev libxml2-dev libncurses-dev pkg-config tzdata zlib1g-dev libpython3-dev libz3-dev; if ! command -v swiftly >/dev/null 2>&1 && [[ ! -x "$HOME/.local/share/swiftly/bin/swiftly" ]]; then tmp_dir="$(mktemp -d)"; curl -fsSL "https://download.swift.org/swiftly/linux/swiftly-$(uname -m).tar.gz" | tar -xz -C "$tmp_dir"; "$tmp_dir/swiftly" init --quiet-shell-followup -y --skip-install; rm -rf "$tmp_dir"; fi; export PATH="$HOME/.local/share/swiftly/bin:$PATH"; if ! command -v swift >/dev/null 2>&1; then swiftly install --use latest -y; rm -f .swift-version; fi; swiftly link -y >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; grep -qxF '. "$HOME/.local/share/swiftly/env.sh"' ~/.bashrc || echo '. "$HOME/.local/share/swiftly/env.sh"' >> ~/.bashrc; fi
